Credit cards are not linked to your bank account. When you spend on a credit card, you borrow the money from the bank. You have the option of paying 100% of your credit card outstanding balance or pay some and let the remaining balance roll over to be billed next month.
You will not be charged with interest charges if you make a 100% payment of your outstanding balance by the due date (excluding cash advances).
